title: Rabbi Levi, Son-in-Law of Rabbi Zecharyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Levi, son-in-law of Rabbi Zechariah.

He is mentioned in Pesikta Rabbati, “Vayehi Bachatzi HaLailah,” section 8, and in Sheiltot, Tzav, reporting Rabbi Berechyah. Hyman suggests the reading should instead be Rabbi Zecharyah, son-in-law of Rabbi Levi, or Rabbi Levi bar Zecharyah, who reports Rabbi Berechyah there.

notes.text: Hyman offers two alternatives to the heading: reversing the son-in-law relationship, or reading a father-and-son relationship. Neither is selected as established.

The consulted Pesikta passage names Levi as Zechariah’s son-in-law and separately has Levi bar Zechariah reporting Berechyah. The section number follows the supplied text. The exact Sheiltot reading remains unverified.
